title: aidoc-flow CI per-repo declaration v1
description: Per-repo shape declaration read by apply-standards.sh and check-standards-drift.sh. PLAN-028 B0. The file is OPTIONAL: an absent file means the single-branch model resolved against the repo's API-reported default branch, which is exactly the behaviour that shipped before this file existed.

model.description: single-branch = today's behaviour (the default, and what an absent file means). dev-staging-main = the PLAN-028 promotion model; adoption is per-repo opt-in.

integration_branch.description: Where feature PRs merge. null = resolve from the GitHub API's default_branch (M4-sec: never hardcode 'main'). Under dev-staging-main this SHOULD also be the repo's default_branch, so Code Scanning alerts and every default-branch resolver anchor to the branch that actually receives merges.

protected_branches.description: Every branch apply-standards.sh protects and check-standards-drift.sh verifies. null = the model's default set: [integration_branch] for single-branch, [integration_branch, staging, main] for dev-staging-main.

promotion_branches.description: The subset of protected_branches that receives FAST-FORWARD promotions rather than PR merges. Each one is protected with the tier profile OVERLAID WITH enforce_admins:false, because that is the only mechanism on a user-owned account that permits the promotion push at all (CI-0048, measured). null = the model's default: [] for single-branch, [staging, main] for dev-staging-main. SECURITY: enforce_admins:false exempts admins from EVERY protection on that branch, so the PR requirement there is advisory, not enforced. Accepted deliberately — see DECISIONS.md CI-0049.
